definitions: Reduce (something) to small particles or powder by crushing it.
Sharpen or smooth (something) with a grinding action.
Rub or cause to rub together with a harsh, grating sound.
Operate (a mill or other machine) by turning a handle.
Work or study hard over a prolonged period.
examples: They grind the wheat into flour.
He had to grind the axe to make it sharp.
She had to grind the coffee beans every morning.
He had to grind away at his studies.
